Welcome back! One agent decided research was its job, Claude Code opened up to modding, and Karpathy found a way to stop models from burying you in prose.  In today's Atlas Newsletter: Claude Code is moddable now: Describe the mod you want, and it appears when the turn ends. An AI agent emails scientists: 2,000 emails since June, none of them requested by its creator. 31 slash commands for running a business: Cash flow, invoices, leads and payroll, all behind an approval step. Why AI needs an airplane manual: Karpathy's fix for five-paragraph answers comes from aerospace maintenance docs. PS: Want to collaborate with the biggest GTM engine and distribution moat for AI companies? You can feature your tool with us and reach millions. Claude Code is moddable now A mod is a small JS or TS file that runs inside your session. It can watch what's happening, change what Claude Code does, or draw its own interface. You don't have to learn the API to build one. Run claude, describe the mod you want, allow hot reload, and it appears when the turn ends. Then keep asking for tweaks and watch them land without restarting. Addy Osmani's guide builds three, and each came from one question someone had. Token Weather: how full is my context?  Draws a line above the prompt with a weather icon, percentage used, tokens against the window and what the last turn cost. Under 25% is Clear. Over 90% is Compact soon. About 80 lines. Blast Radius: what is this command about to delete?  Holds rm -rf, git reset --hard, force pushes and migrations, works out what would actually be touched, and opens a pane with Proceed and Cancel. Replay Theater: what did Claude just change?  Records every Edit and Write during a turn, then steps you through the diffs. Every hook is middleware, which gives you three moves.  Observe and look at the result. Rewrite what the chain sees. Or answer and refuse the call outright. Claude Code uses mods for its own features, including AGENTS.md support and the /diff pane.  That source is public, so you can read how the team builds them. One real caution from the guide. A mod runs inside Claude Code with the same access Claude Code has, written by its publisher rather than Anthropic.  Read the repo before you install. Needs 2.1.287 or later. On by default. Master Claude Code in 6 sessions You already know the developers who seem to move twice as fast as everyone else.

🧠 Crypto News Brief: Bitcoin pushes toward $87K as soft US jobs data erases October Fed hike bets, while Wall Street's tokenization race accelerates with OKX and ICE filing for 24/7 onchain stock trading. Institutions keep building rails. 🏛️ OKX and NYSE Owner ICE File for 24/7 Tokenized US Stock Trading OKXICE, the 50-50 joint venture of OKX and NYSE parent Intercontinental Exchange, has notified the SEC that it plans to run a round-the-clock venue for tokenized versions of more than 60 US-listed stocks under the agency's new Innovation Exemption. Each token will trade against USDC, USDG or USDT in permissioned Uniswap v4 pools on OKX's X Layer, and listed companies get 30 days to opt out — chipmaker Cerebras has already objected. Read full story 📈 Bitcoin Tops $86K as Weak Jobs Data Kills October Fed Hike Bets BTC climbed about 1% to just above $86,000 on Monday after a soft September US jobs report led traders to abandon bets on an October rate hike by the Federal Reserve. Still capped below $87,000, the market needs to hold above $87,200 to confirm the next leg higher, according to QCP, with FOMC minutes due Wednesday and the 10-year Treasury yield at 5.25%. More details 🏦 Kraken Parent Payward Adds 24/7 Dollar Settlement With Singapore Gulf Bank Payward, the company behind Kraken, has plugged into SGB Net, the real-time clearing network of Bahrain-regulated Singapore Gulf Bank, giving select institutional clients in Asia and the Gulf instant US dollar settlement at any hour, including non-banking days. The bank will also tap Kraken Prime for digital asset liquidity, and both firms plan to add more currencies and clients. Read more 🪙 Metaplanet Ends Q3 With 44,000 BTC After Sell-and-Rebuy Liquidity Test Tokyo-listed Metaplanet added a net 1,000 BTC in the third quarter, lifting its holdings to 44,000 BTC (about $3.8 billion) as of Sept. 30. The firm sold 10,000 BTC and then bought back 11,000 BTC to show creditors it can convert its treasury to cash, a move aimed at securing a credit rating and widening access to bond and preferred-share funding. See details ⏳ Ethereum Staking Exit Queue Hits 2026 High as MetaMask Pulls Validators Ether waiting to leave staking jumped more than fivefold in three days to roughly 851,000 ETH, the longest exit line of 2026, as MetaMask withdrew validators it runs for Lido following a Sept. 30 security inciden
